title: Observe how events pass through the parent container and button
goal: identifies capture, target, and bubbling phases with the help of listening callbacks.
summary: The interaction log shows the order in which the same click passes through the outer and inner layers. The parent container listens for both capture and bubbling.
tasks: is recorded with capture listening on #pad "outer layer capture" and on #tap with normal listening "button".
uses normal monitoring to record "outer layer bubbling" on #pad, connects this sequence with " → " and writes it to #trace, and starts recording the next time.

example.code:
parent.addEventListener('click', trackCapture, { capture: true });
parent.addEventListener('click', trackBubble);
example.note: The capture listener is executed inward along the path, and the listener on the target is executed before bubbling along the parent.

hint: uses a step array to collect text, output it in the bubbling listener of the parent container and then clear it.
